Description: Automated daily data ingestion and discrepancy monitoring engine across all DSP endpoints.

Summary: Ingest Daily DSP Billing Logs & Join First-Party Ad Server Impressions
Description:
*As an* Ad-Ops Revenue Analyst,
*I want* an automated daily ETL pipeline pulling delivery and billing logs from DSP partners (DV360, TTD, Amazon, Xandr),
*So that* impression matching and financial reconciliation occur within 24 hours of campaign delivery rather than at month-end.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
{code}
Scenario: Ingest partner delivery logs at scheduled window
Given DSP reporting feeds drop data daily at 04:00 UTC
When the ingestion script parses impression IDs and delivery timestamps
Then log data is validated against the internal schema and written to the reconciliation staging table with zero unmapped placement IDs.
{code}

Summary: Deploy Automated 2.0% MSA SLA Discrepancy Evaluator & Alerting
Description:
*As an* Ad-Ops Operations Lead,
*I want* an automated calculation engine that computes (Server Impressions - Billed Impressions) / Server Impressions,
*So that* any partner or placement exceeding the contractual 2.0% discrepancy tolerance immediately triggers an automated operational ticket.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
{code}
Scenario: Trigger discrepancy threshold breach alert
Given the daily matched volume shows total server delivery of 120,000 and partner billing of 111,351
When the discrepancy calculator computes a 7.21% drop rate
Then the system flags an MSA SLA breach and generates a Sev-2 triage alert with affected placement IDs.
{code}

Summary: Implement Client-Side 850ms Fallback Tag to Eliminate Timeout Drops
Description:
*As a* Revenue Optimization Engineer,
*I want* to implement a client-side circuit breaker firing at 850ms,
*So that* auction callbacks exceeding the 1,000ms gateway drop threshold fail gracefully over to cached, pre-approved creative inventory.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
{code}
Scenario: Preempt network timeout at 850ms mark
Given an outbound DSP win-notice/tag request is running
When the roundtrip response latency crosses 850ms without completion
Then the client script terminates the hanging socket and renders the fallback cached unit, reducing >1,000ms dropped units by >90%.
{code}

*As a* Media Performance Analyst,
*I want* a position-based attribution engine that distributes 40% credit to first touch, 40% to last touch, and 20% across middle interactions,
*So that* upper-funnel prospecting inventory is not unfairly undervalued compared to retargeting channels.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
{code}
Scenario: Attribute multi-touch journey credit
Given a user journey with 5 verified touchpoints totaling $100 in revenue
When the attribution query runs across the path
Then $40 is assigned to touchpoint 1, $40 to touchpoint 5, and $6.67 is split evenly across touchpoints 2, 3, and 4.
